context: In this paper, we gave a new method for finding a set of disjoint 3-augmenting paths that allows√the augmentation of a maximal matching such that the resulting matching is of size at least 2 − 2 times the size of a maximum matching. Our method is simple and only requires running the Greedy matching algorithm on a random subgraph. We applied this method in the data streaming setting and improved over the state-of-the-art one-pass random order algorithm and the state-of-the-art two- and three-pass adversarial order algorithms. How large a matching can we compute in a single pass in the random order setting? All relevant known lower bounds for matchings [18, 22, 19] are highly sensitive to the arrival order of the edges and do not translate to the random order setting.
